what: ADS-B ground fixes of aircraft at HWD in 5 m cells (tools/adsb/ground_cells.py); row = [x, z (cell centre, world m, hwd_frame.py), n_move (fixes with gs >= 1 kt), n_still, n_aircraft (distinct), n_heli (helicopter fixes)]; one fix per aircraft, cell and moving/still state per 10 s

attribution: Contains information from ADSB.lol (https://adsb.lol), made available under the ODbL 1.0 (https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/).
selection: ground flag or ground by kinematics (derive.py GK_H 30 ft / GK_GS 35 kt), seen_pos <= 2 s, NACp >= 8, aircraft type (not a vehicle pseudo-type) or category A1-A7, <= 2500 m from the ARP
note: positions are GNSS antenna positions (not the aircraft centre); NACp 10 parked-fix scatter p50 0.55 m, p90 1.5 m (hwd_parked_stays.json position_noise_per_fix)
